# EcoLedger

Product key: ecoledger
Aliases: EcoLedger AI
Canonical product: https://eco-ledger-ai-379a7af4.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/ecoledger/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/ecoledger/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- organize an ecological restoration project
- track restoration baselines photos and measurements
- build an evidence record for habitat restoration work
- review ecological restoration project progress
- keep restoration observations and review status together
- explore an ecological restoration evidence library

## Authority

public discovery and restoration-library access with authenticated workspace or pilot handoff for nonpublic project records

## Boundaries

- do not treat an uploaded photo or measurement as independently verified without supporting evidence
- private property records, project media and account data remain outside public discovery
- EcoLedger does not automatically create regulatory certification or compliance approval
- pilot or contact intake creates no payment obligation unless separate verified terms are accepted

## Universal Evercraft routing

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
